血煞宗，除了宗主血无涯之外，全军覆没！
整个世界，在这一刻，都仿佛被按下了静音键。
所有还活着的烟雨楼弟子，全都石化在了原地，他们张大着嘴巴，眼珠子都快瞪出来了，满脸都是无法用言语形容的震撼和狂热！
秦月白和秦婠婠母女，也彻底傻了。
她们呆呆地看着那满天的血雾，又看了看天空中那个只是随意挥了挥手的黑衣青年，
感觉自己的世界观，在这一刻被彻底颠覆了。
他双腿一软，直接瘫倒在地，裤裆处传来一阵骚臭味，竟是直接被吓尿了！
像一条狗一样趴在地上，对着天空中的江渊等人，疯狂地磕头求饶。
“我错了！我有眼不识泰山！求求你们，把我当个屁放了吧！”
然而，江渊轻抬眼眸，居高临下地看着这个刚才还不可一世，现在却如同死狗一般的魔宗宗主，声音平静地说道：
血无涯感受着江渊身上那弱小的气息，眼中闪过一丝错愕和疑惑。
一个3境的小修士，怎么可能是这群恐怖存在的主人？
这个念头一出来，就像野草一样在他心里疯狂滋长。
求生的**，让他瞬间失去了理智。
血无涯眼中凶光一闪，猛地从地上一跃而起，用尽全身的魔功，化作一只巨大的血爪，朝着近在咫尺的江渊，狠狠抓了过去！
江毅和福生的声音同时响起，就要出手。
他看着那只离自己越来越近的血爪，脸上没有丝毫的慌乱。
就在血爪即将触碰到他的瞬间，他缓缓抬起了手。
一把通体漆黑，造型古朴的长剑，出现在他手中。
正是六祖给他的那把弑帝剑（仿）（仿）。
然后，他对着那只巨大的血爪，随手一剑，斩了下去！
没有剧烈的爆炸，没有能量的对冲。
血无涯的眼珠子瞪得滚圆，脸上写满了无法理解的惊骇。
他还没反应过来，那道黑色的剑光，在斩碎了血爪之后，
余势不减，直接从他的身体中间，一划而过。
一道细微的黑线，从他的额头，一直延伸到他的胯下。
然后，他的身体连带着他的神魂，就那么悄无声息地，化作了最原始的粒子，彻底消散在了天地之间。
一代魔宗宗主，树林界的最强者，形神俱灭！
整个烟雨楼，再次陷入了死一般的寂静。
所有人都呆呆地看着天空中那个持剑而立的白衣身影，感觉就像是在做梦一样。
一个3境神魄境的年轻人，一剑就斩杀了一个6境神通境的魔道巨擘！
这已经不是越级挑战了，这是在创造神话！
秦月白和秦婠婠母女，更是美眸圆睁，小嘴微张，完全被眼前这一幕给震傻了。
她们本以为，江渊只是一个身份尊贵的公子哥，真正的强者是他身后的护卫。
可谁能想到，这位公子哥自己，竟然也强得如此离谱！
江渊收起弑帝剑，满意地点了点头。
不愧是圣器，哪怕只是仿品的仿品，威力也够可以的。
他转过身，目光落在下方那对已经完全呆滞的母女身上，脸上重新挂起了温和的笑容。
他一步步从空中走下，缓缓落在了她们面前。

Chapter 25 Do you really think I want to fight you (Page 1)
The Blood Evil Sect, except for its leader Xue Wuya, was completely wiped out!
The whole world, at this moment, seemed to have pressed the mute button.
All the Yanyulou disciples who were still alive were petrified on the spot. Their mouths were wide open, their eyes almost popped out, their faces were full of shock and enthusiasm that could not be described in words!
Mother and daughter Qin Yuebai and Qin Hanhan were also completely stunned.
They stared blankly at the blood mist in the sky, and then looked at the young man in black in the sky who just waved his hand casually.
I felt like my world view was completely overturned at this moment.
His legs went weak and he collapsed directly to the ground. There was a foul smell coming from his crotch, and he was so frightened that he peed!
Lying on the ground like a dog, he kowtowed crazily to Jiang Yuan and others in the sky, begging for mercy.
"I was wrong! I couldn't see the truth! Please, just treat me like a fart!"
然而，江渊轻抬眼眸，居高临下地看着这个刚才还不可一世，现在却如同死狗一般的魔宗宗主，声音平静地说道：
Xue Wuya felt the weak aura on Jiang Yuan's body, and a trace of astonishment and doubt flashed in his eyes.
How could a young monk in Level 3 be the master of these terrifying beings?
As soon as this idea came out, it grew like a weed in his heart.
The desire to survive made him lose his mind instantly.
A fierce light flashed in Xue Wuya's eyes, and he suddenly jumped up from the ground. He used all his magic power to turn into a huge bloody claw, and grabbed Jiang Yuan who was very close at hand!
Jiang Yi and Fu Sheng's voices sounded at the same time, and they were about to take action.
He looked at the bloody claw getting closer and closer to him, without any panic on his face.
Just when the bloody claw was about to touch him, he slowly raised his hand.
A dark, simple-looking long sword appeared in his hand.
It was the emperor-killing sword (imitation) (imitation) given to him by the Sixth Patriarch.
Then, he slashed at the huge bloody claw with a sword!
There was no violent explosion, no rush of energy.
Xue Wuya's eyes widened, and his face was filled with incomprehensible horror.
Before he could react, the black sword light, after smashing the blood claw,
The remaining force continued unabated and passed directly through the middle of his body.
A subtle black line stretched from his forehead to his crotch.
Then, his body, together with his soul, so quietly turned into the most primitive particles and completely dissipated between heaven and earth.
The leader of the Demon Sect, the strongest man in the forest world, was destroyed physically and mentally!
The entire Yanyu Tower fell into deathly silence again.
Everyone stared blankly at the figure in white standing in the sky holding a sword, feeling as if they were dreaming.
A young man who was in the 3rd level of the divine soul realm killed a demon giant who was in the 6th level of the divine power realm with one sword!
This is no longer a leapfrog challenge, this is creating a myth!
Mother and daughter Qin Yuebai, Qin Hanhan, their beautiful eyes widened and their mouths slightly opened, were completely shocked by the scene in front of them.
They originally thought that Jiang Yuan was just a noble son, and the real strong ones were the guards behind him.
But who would have thought that this young master himself would be so ridiculously strong!
Jiang Yuan put away the emperor-killing sword and nodded with satisfaction.
It is worthy of being a holy weapon, even if it is just an imitation, it is powerful enough.
He turned around, his eyes falling on the mother and daughter below who were completely stunned, and a gentle smile resumed on his face.
He walked down from the air step by step and slowly landed in front of them.
